subject.title: feat(ui): match ClickClack discussion sidebars to host themes

question: Should OpenClaw treat the merged ClickClack receiver contract as the supported deployment prerequisite for emitting `openclawHostTheme=1` and cross-origin palette messages?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately cross-repository and security-boundary-sensitive; deciding its supported receiver/version lifecycle is an owner choice rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Confirm paired receiver contract
options.body: Recommended: confirm the ClickClack receiver changes are the supported counterpart, then rebase and merge after the pending exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Require explicit compatibility boundary
options.body: Document or enforce a ClickClack receiver version/capability boundary before allowing the host to send first-paint tokens and live updates.

options.title: Pause cross-repository rollout
options.body: Keep the existing unthemed iframe behavior until the receiver contract has a maintainer-approved deployment story.

recommendation.title: Confirm paired receiver contract
recommendation.body: Recommended: confirm the ClickClack receiver changes are the supported counterpart, then rebase and merge after the pending exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR history and linked receiver work identify this contributor as the clearest routing point for the shared implementation contract.
